name: modelIdle
meaning: Main model slot, the outMain argument of ScnObject_InitWithAltModels; selected by WaterMine_SetIdleModel when the mine sits more than 20 units below the water surface. AltModel is 0x10 bytes, so 0x7c+0x10 = 0x8c lands exactly on the alt array.

name: altModels
meaning: Four alternates resolved from the id table at 0x576fe4 = u16 {3, 0x5a, 0xdf, 0xe0}: [0] +0x8c shallow blast (anim 3), [1] +0x9c aftermath (anim 1), [2] +0xac deep blast (anim 2), [3] +0xbc floating/surface idle (anim 0). 4 * 0x10 = 0x40, so 0x8c..0xcb.

name: triggerBox
meaning: 300-unit cube centred on the mine's LOAD position (min = pos-150 at +0xd0, max = pos+150 at +0xd6), the broad-phase query box for victims. The flags dword at +0xcc is never written, and ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap reads only +4/+8/+0xa/+0xe. Never rebuilt, so a moved mine keeps its old trigger.

name: waterBox
meaning: The water zone containing the mine, from BoxList_FindContainingPoint over g_waterZones 0x6d0c58; its min on the vertical (+6, down-positive so min is the surface) is the water level. Null-checked before every use.

name: homePos
meaning: Position captured in PostLoadInit as dword+word (0xe0..0xe5); restored by Reset through ScnMobile_SetPosition, and its vertical +0xe2 is what both depth tests compare against the water surface - the saved one, not the live position.

name: state
meaning: 0 armed, 1 blast animation playing, 2 spent. State 2 has no case body, so it is terminal until Reset.

name: flags
meaning: Bit 0 = the mine has detonated and its visual state needs restoring; it is the only gate on Reset's call to WaterMine_SetIdleModel (0x507642), and SetIdleModel clears it with `and al,-2`.
